isnad_chains.desc_en: The most authentic chain of narration according to Imam Bukhari: Malik → Nafi' → Ibn Umar
isnad_chains.desc_tr: İmam Buhârî'nin 'esahhu'l-esânîd' dediği en sahih isnâd zinciri: Mâlik → Nâfi' → İbn Ömer

isnad_chains.desc_en: Extension of the Golden Chain: Malik → al-Shafi'i → Ahmad ibn Hanbal — connecting three great imams
isnad_chains.desc_tr: Altın zincirin devamı: Mâlik → Şâfiî → Ahmed b. Hanbel — üç büyük imamı birbirine bağlar

isnad_chains.desc_en: Chain of the first hadith in Sahih al-Bukhari: Ibn Abbas → Amr ibn Dinar → Sufyan ibn Uyayna → al-Humaydi → Bukhari
isnad_chains.desc_tr: Sahîh-i Buhârî'nin ilk hadisinin isnâd zinciri: İbn Abbâs → Amr b. Dînâr → Süfyân b. Uyeyne → Humeydî → Buhârî

isnad_chains.desc_en: Most authentic chain among female narrators: Aisha → Urwa ibn al-Zubayr → Ibn Shihab al-Zuhri
isnad_chains.desc_tr: Kadın râviler arasında en sahih zincir: Hz. Âişe → Urve b. Zübeyr → İbn Şihâb ez-Zührî

isnad_chains.desc_en: Backbone of the Kufa fiqh tradition: Ibn Masud → Alqama → Ibrahim al-Nakha'i → Hammad → Abu Hanifa
isnad_chains.desc_tr: Kûfe fıkıh geleneğinin omurgası: İbn Mes'ûd → Alkame → İbrâhîm en-Nehaî → Hammâd → Ebû Hanîfe

isnad_chains.desc_en: Main branch of the Kufa hadith tradition: Ibn Masud → Abu Wa'il → al-A'mash → Sufyan al-Thawri
isnad_chains.desc_tr: Kûfe hadis geleneğinin ana kolu: İbn Mes'ûd → Ebû Vâil → A'meş → Süfyân es-Sevrî

isnad_chains.desc_en: Ibrahim al-Nakha'i → Mansur → Sufyan al-Thawri — second branch parallel to al-A'mash
isnad_chains.desc_tr: İbrâhîm en-Nehaî → Mansûr → Süfyân es-Sevrî — A'meş ile paralel ikinci kol

isnad_chains.desc_en: Main chain of the Basra hadith tradition: Anas ibn Malik → Qatada → Shu'ba
isnad_chains.desc_tr: Basra hadis geleneğinin ana zinciri: Enes b. Mâlik → Katâde → Şu'be

isnad_chains.desc_en: Ibn Umar → Salim → Ibn Shihab al-Zuhri → Malik — second main branch of the Medinan school
isnad_chains.desc_tr: İbn Ömer → Sâlim → İbn Şihâb ez-Zührî → Mâlik — Medine okulunun ikinci ana kolu

isnad_chains.desc_en: Chain of the Companion with most narrations: Abu Hurayra → Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab → al-Zuhri → Malik
isnad_chains.desc_tr: En çok rivayet eden sahâbî zinciri: Ebû Hüreyre → Saîd b. Müseyyeb → Zührî → Mâlik
